properties.name: 2.00in hail 2 NW Shelter Cove (11/13 2100Z = 3:00 PM CST) - Confirmed: measured
properties.description:
Basis: Confirmed: measured
Single public report of 2" hail (LSR qualifier M); radar (MESH 0.54") and HailTrace do not corroborate - low confidence, no buildings.
MRMS MESH there only 0.54" (radar did not show 2"); HailTrace public 11/13: 3 est. properties at 1"+, 0 at 1.75"+. Ground report is a single public report with LSR qualifier M (measured; basis rank 1 per rule); kept as a qualifying event, but 0 C/I buildings >=10,000 SF within 5 mi (rural coastal Humboldt Co.), so no building lead.
